title: Silent Aim Hitbox Expander Skin Changer More
features:
Aimbot – Smooth aim assistance with customizable FOV, aim key, target part, team check, and visibility check.

Silent Aim – Redirects shots toward targets without moving your camera.

Ragebot – High-speed automated targeting with visibility and team filtering.

Triggerbot – Automatically fires when your crosshair is over an enemy.

Trigger Delay – Adjusts the delay before Triggerbot fires.

Hitbox Expander – Enlarges enemy hitboxes with adjustable size and transparency.

Box ESP – Displays 2D, 3D, or Corner Boxes around players.

Skeleton ESP – Draws player skeletons for improved visibility.

Tracer ESP – Draws tracers from your screen to enemy players.

Name ESP – Displays player names.

Health ESP – Shows player health bars.

Distance ESP – Displays the distance to each player.

Head Circle – Draws a circle around enemy heads.

Skin Changer – Applies custom weapon skins.

Fire Rate Changer – Adjusts weapon fire rate.

No Recoil – Removes weapon recoil.

No Spread – Eliminates bullet spread for improved accuracy.

Anti-Flash – Prevents flashbang effects.

Anti-Smoke – Removes smoke effects for better visibility.
